policy.browserLines: Current and immediately preceding stable product major on a named OS. Exact patches must be resolved at acquisition; installed versions are inventory, not test results. Beta/Canary/Technology Preview and bundled engines are separate subjects.
policy.frameworkLines: At each support-window acquisition, select the latest stable minor and the immediately preceding stable minor within the current stable major; pin the highest stable patch published in each selected line. Retain existing previous-major compatibility cohorts separately. This is a library compatibility window, not an assertion that upstream maintains every previous line. Prereleases are excluded. Re-resolve on support-window changes, never relabel historical results.
policy.evidence: A passed historical subset retains its original date, inputs and limits. No new run, source-equivalence transfer, physical-device or screen-reader acceptance is inferred from this inventory.
policy.refresh: Refresh this ledger when package pins or qualification receipts change and before release. Recheck official product versions at acquisition; do not silently upgrade runtime pins or rewrite historical receipts.
